Press a keyboard key (Enter) and verify success

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { PageAction, createEngine, interact } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: "always" } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await interact(engine, url, [{ selector: "#searchbox", kind: "click" } as PageAction, { selector: "#searchbox", text: "test", kind: "type" } as PageAction, { key: "Enter", kind: "press" } as PageAction]);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
